name: Grade 7 IIT Practice: July Week 3 - Scratch Intro
description: Practice words for Scratch sequences and events.

words.definition: A block coding tool for making programs and games.
words.example: The student opened Scratch to build the first game scene.

words.definition: A character or object in a Scratch or mBlock project.
words.example: The sprite moved when the player pressed an arrow key.

words.definition: A group of connected blocks that run together.
words.example: The script made the sprite say a message.

words.definition: Something that starts an action in a program.
words.example: The green flag event started the project.

words.definition: A coding command that snaps into a program.
words.example: The motion block moved the sprite ten steps.
The sequence played a sound, moved, and changed costume.
